name: Wall of Stone

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: ten connected 10-foot panels on a solid surface

summary: Raise a wall of solid stone; it becomes permanent if you hold Concentration the whole time.
text: It is made of ten 10-by-10-foot panels 6 inches thick (or ten 10-by-20 panels 3 inches thick); each panel has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points per inch of thickness. A creature in its path is pushed aside, with a Dex save to choose the side.
